project.name: Trailhead
project.idea: A trail-finder that ranks hikes near a city by how much shade they get, so summer hikers stop getting cooked. Search a city, get three ranked suggestions with a shade score and why.
project.knownStack: TypeScript, Next.js, Supabase. Nobody has done map tiles before.
project.demoTarget: Type 'Austin', see three trails ranked by shade score, click one, see the score explained on a map.
mustWork: the ranking endpoint returns three trails for Austin in under 2s
the shade score explanation renders for at least one trail

roles.name: Frontend
roles.description: Search box, ranked results list, and the trail detail page with the score explanation.
mustCover: what the empty state and the loading state show
the exact shape frontend expects from the ranking endpoint
what renders when a trail has no shade data

roles.name: Backend
roles.description: The ranking endpoint, the trails data model, and seeding trail data for the demo city.
mustCover: exact request and response shape of POST /api/rank
table and column names with types
what an error response looks like to the UI

roles.name: Shade model
roles.description: The scoring: how tree cover, aspect, and time of day become one 0-100 shade score, computed at seed time.
mustCover: the exact fields the score explanation exposes to the detail page
whether scores are precomputed at seed time or computed per request
